install: npm ci && if [ -x /usr/bin/chromium ]; then touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; elif [ -z "${CHROMIUM_PATH:-}" ]; then npx playwright install chromium; fi
